spans.s:
सृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, let go, let loose; poured out,
emitted; given away; created, made; ascertained;
sent away, abandoned, deserted, left; joined, at-
tached, connected; ornamented, adorned; abundant,
much, many.

सृष्टवत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has let go or
created or made.

सृष्टि, इस्, f. letting go, letting loose, emission;
giving away, gift; creation, procreation, creating;
the creation of the world, (मनोरथ-स्˚, mental
creation, fiction of the imagination); nature, natural
property or disposition; the existence of properties
or qualities; the absence of properties.
—सृष्टि-
कर्तृ, ता, m. a creator, maker.
—सृष्टि-खण्ड,
N. of the first book of the Padma-Purāṇa.
—सृष्टि-
प्रदा, f. ‘causing procreation,’ a particular shrub
(= गर्भ-दात्री).

सृष्ट्वा, ind. having let go; having created;
having abandoned.
